If you’re visiting Kaza, staying at Sonam Homestay is something you absolutely shouldn’t miss. It was honestly one of the best homestay experiences I’ve ever had.
From the moment we arrived, the owners welcomed us with such warmth that it instantly felt like we were not guests, but a part of their home. There’s something so genuine and comforting about their hospitality- it’s not just service, it’s pure care and kindness.
The rooms had the most beautiful views-waking up to those serene mountains and the peaceful vibe of Kaza was an experience in itself. Everything was simple yet so thoughtfully arranged, making our stay feel cozy and special.
One of my favorite memories was the evening we spent there- we had a little concert while enjoying our dinner, and it turned into such a wholesome, unforgettable moment. The food was delicious, made with so much love, and added to that homely feeling.
Aunty, especially, was incredibly sweet and caring. She went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable at all times- checking in on us, making sure we had everything we needed, and just making us feel truly looked after.
It’s rare to find a place that gives you both comfort and emotional warmth, but Sonam Homestay does exactly that. It’s not just a place to stay, it’s an experience you carry back with you.
If you ever plan a trip to Kaza, make sure you stay here for at least a day- I promise, it will be one of those memories you’ll never forget. ❤️
